newsitem.title: UK: UK's budget to offer investment incentives-paper.
newsitem.headline: UK's budget to offer investment incentives-paper.

text.p: UK's Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown is expected to announce substantial new tax incentives for capital investments for UK companies as part of his first budget, the Financial Times said on Monday.
The budget, to be unveiled on July 2, is expected to contain incentives for companies to buy capital goods with a medium-term life expectancy, the paper said.
The main element will be the abolition of the 20 percent tax credit on dividend payments.
Brown also is likely to announce a partial reversal of the recent tax allowances for big companies investing in long life machinery and equipment, the paper said. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
